params.caption: 🎮 Lost PokéPark DS game resurfaces after 20 years, then gets sealed in a PSA slab A playable copy of a 20-year-old PokéPark game for the Nintendo DS, long considered lost, has finally turned up. Instead of being preserved and shared online, it was graded and sealed in a PSA slab, leaving Pokémon fans and preservationists furious that the game may stay out of reach. 🕒 Nov 14, 2026 · 18:06 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 👥 @Pokemon 😤 Preserve it or keep it sealed? React and tell us below 💬 #Pokemon #PokePark #NintendoDS #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
